primary:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final primary horizontal logo for the existing brand "My Games", a personal video-game library, playtime tracker and social gaming journal, used in website header, desktop app and brand materials.
Design a polished, distinctive minimal combination logo on pure white. Symbol left, wordmark right. The symbol is a compact geometric monogram M made from two interlocking thick game-cover/card shapes, communicating a personal collection. Include one clear right-pointing play triangle as negative space inside the symbol. It must read as one memorable bold silhouette with only a few large shapes, rounded corners and a confident central M valley. No thin details. Symbol color soft mint green #7EE2A8 with a small darker evergreen #256D50 overlap if needed; wordmark deep charcoal #0B0C10. Wordmark EXACTLY "My Games" with uppercase M and G, two words, on one line. Clean custom geometric sans typography, moderately wide, akin to Unbounded/Manrope, balanced letterspacing, medium-bold, excellent readability. Make the mark and text balanced in optical height with a generous clear gap. Restrained mature gaming aesthetic suitable for the app's charcoal Salon theme. Flat vector-like shapes, crisp edges, production logo, centered on a landscape canvas with reasonable clear space. No extra text, no tagline, no labels, no mockup, no environment, no controller clip art, no mascot, no gradients, no lighting, no shadows, no texture, no watermark. White background.
